title: App window: drop the system frame so Grillo's own frame is the window
story: Grillo used to show the Windows frame and title bar with Grillo's own glass frame drawn inside it, like a window inside a window. Now Grillo's glass panel is the window: you move it by dragging Grillo's title bar, and the normal minimise, maximise and close buttons sit inside that bar. Snap layouts, double-click to maximise and edge resizing work as before.

checks.criterion: The glass panel is the whole window, with no system title bar and no gap around it.
checks.steps: Start the app on Windows: npm run build, set GRILLO_STORE=memory, then npx electron .
checks.expected: One frame only: Grillo's title bar (logo, 'Grillo', 'Setup check') is the top of the window, minimise, maximise and close at its right end, no gap or inner rounded panel at the edges.

checks.criterion: Dragging the title bar moves the window; double-clicking it maximises and restores.
checks.steps: Start the app on Windows: npm run build, set GRILLO_STORE=memory, then npx electron . Drag the empty part of the title bar. Double-click it, then double-click again.
checks.expected: The window follows the mouse; the first double-click maximises, the second restores.

checks.criterion: The three system buttons work and hovering over maximise shows the snap layouts.
checks.steps: Start the app on Windows: npm run build, set GRILLO_STORE=memory, then npx electron . Hover over maximise. Click minimise, restore from the taskbar, click maximise twice, click close.
checks.expected: The snap-layout flyout on hover; each button does its job; close quits the app.

checks.criterion: The window resizes from its edges.
checks.steps: Start the app on Windows: npm run build, set GRILLO_STORE=memory, then npx electron . Drag the left, right and bottom edges and the bottom-right corner.
checks.expected: The window resizes from each one.

checks.criterion: On Mac the native buttons stay and do not cover the logo.
checks.steps: On a Mac: npm run build, then npx electron .
checks.expected: Red, yellow and green buttons at the top left inside Grillo's title bar, with the logo to their right.
